title: Cozy and independent space
description:
An elegant, comfortable, and private basement apartment attached to the main house. Enjoy a lovingly decorated space with rustic charm. You can relax and enjoy the peace and comfort we offer.
Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally located accommodation, just 15 minutes from the city center and the airport.  It's also very close to Nashville's best attractions.

The space
The apartment is a cozy private space with three spacious rooms: the bedroom with its closet, the dining area where we have a pool table in front of the kitchen and a desk with a chair for working, and finally the living room where we have a large sofa bed and the television.

Guest access
The entire apartment area, the porch, and the parking space are the areas designated for guests.

Other things to note
This property has all the necessary licenses and operates in full compliance with the regulations of the City of Nashville and Davidson County.
